caption:

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left facing a large page on the right, and a small counter above the page reads x1. Its eyes sweep to the left and then slowly to the right along a line, then narrow, then it starts again, and the counter goes x2, x3, x4, x5. At the end its eyes go wide and it narrows its eyes at the camera. The text stays: me reading the same line for the fifth time.
